purpose: Pinned source adapters before bundling: embed Scalar as a named section within the host main, retain the API-client dialog without a second main including its hidden lifecycle, and omit unrenderable text Lazy placeholders whose actual introduction/Markdown content already has a canonical anchor. Raw npm bytes remain intact; no served DOM or minified-output repair. Modal disclosure attrs assign IDs only to the intended panel while retaining root classes; table rows omit nonunique parameter-name IDs while preserving fields and model identity. The existing modal Escape handler owns closure before the open-state watcher releases focus trapping.
